Why Choose the 2-Step Challenge
Balance-Based Drawdown
Not equity-based, on any program
Your drawdown levels are calculated from your account balance, not equity, so a winning trade never shrinks your remaining buffer. That gives you room to let a good trade play out instead of getting stopped out early.
Trade News and Weekends
Built for clean, uninterrupted trading
News trading, weekend holding, and overnight holding are all allowed on the 2-Step Challenge, so you can trade your normal strategy without extra restrictions.
Up to 100% Profit Share
No add-ons, no slower payouts
Climb to 100% profit share through the CTI VIP ladder, with no extra fees and no trade-off on how often you get paid. A bigger share and faster payouts go hand in hand.
First Payout in 7 Days
Fast, straightforward payouts
Request your first payout from CTI in as little as 7 days, with weekly and anytime options as you climb the VIP ladder.
80% Profit Share
Starts high, climbs higher
The 2-Step starts you at 80% profit share the moment you’re funded, before any VIP progression, so you keep the majority of what you earn right away.
No Consistency Rules
Straightforward rules, no fine print
The 2-Step Challenge has no hidden consistency requirements, with clear target and drawdown objectives.

What is the CTI 2-Step Challenge?

The 2-Step Challenge is CTI’s classic two-phase evaluation. Hit a 10% profit target in Phase 1 and a 5% profit target in Phase 2, with no time limit on either phase, and you’ll move to a funded account with an 80% profit share that scales up to 100% through our VIP program.

How does the drawdown work on the 2-Step?
The 2-Step uses a static drawdown of 10% of your initial balance, plus a daily drawdown of 5% of your initial balance, deducted from each day’s starting balance.
Can I trade news, use EAs, or hold over weekends?
Yes to news, weekend holding, and overnight holding, all allowed with no restrictions. Personal Expert Advisors are permitted, but third-party EAs and Martingale strategies are not.
Should I choose the 1-Step or 2-Step?
Both paths lead to the same place: a funded account and real profit share. Choose the 1-Step if you want to get there as fast as possible in a single phase, or want the lowest entry cost. Choose the 2-Step if you’d rather ease in with two smaller targets, one phase at a time.
